# Pmi006 — Saved-view name location ambiguous (camera_model_d3 vs model_geometric_view)

**Fixture**: [`step-examples/12-7-pmi/Pmi006.stp`](../../step-examples/12-7-pmi/Pmi006.stp)  
**Sender**: CATIA prefers `camera_model_d3.name`; Creo prefers `model_geometric_view.name`  

## Sources
- 02-caxif (PMI v4.1 §9.4.2)

## Description

Older guidance put the Saved-View name on `camera_model_d3.name`. AP242 Ed.2+ recommends `model_geometric_view.name`. Files omitting the name from `model_geometric_view` are read as anonymous by Ed.2-only readers.

## Reproducer recipe

STEP file with two `camera_model_d3` instances both named "Front", one `draughting_model` per camera, no `model_geometric_view`.

## Expected kernel behavior

On import, look at `model_geometric_view.name` first, fall back to `camera_model_d3.name`; on export emit both.
